dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior edge of the interscapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 35% of the visible dorsal torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the inner margins of the pinnae is approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistently smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the top of the ear boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-yellow discoloration or staining of the fur in the ventral and lower dorsal regions.
